p0_findings.title: two contexts per phase cannot accept one legal atomic M523 interior bundle
p0_findings.evidence: M523 atomically presents four distinct odd-odd destinations in the first full-eight bundle of an interior event, while M534 provides only two contexts in that phase and allows partial retirement only at frontier or fence.
p0_findings.impact: The minimum leaf has no legal accept or release transition without dropping lanes, early close, uncharged state, or deadlock.

p1_findings.title: A1-ISO8 is not the strongest exact baseline
p1_findings.required_fix: Add same-resource source-centric K8 A1 and conventional output-stationary or Gustavson A1; report PDR only against the strongest exact point.

p1_findings.title: M218 six-slice physical service is absent from the cycle definition
p1_findings.required_fix: Freeze the six 16-lane request expansion, eight 128-bit banks, L4, O8, FIFO4, response ordering, busy contexts and Acc24 update schedule for both points.

p1_findings.title: psum and weight memory costs are under-specified
p1_findings.required_fix: Freeze tile size, macro depth and width, port type, latency, refill, RMW, forwarding, spill and commit rules, plus state ownership and energy transactions.

p1_findings.title: decoder share gate would mix S10 decoder with S100 included scope
p1_findings.required_fix: Generate a same-S10 included-scope denominator or remove the system-share gate from the local CPU fast-kill.

p1_findings.title: ELSA directly neighbors destination-row batching and dependency completion
p1_findings.required_fix: Cite ELSA mini-batch Gustavson and output scheduler; narrow the claim to transposed-convolution parity frontier under bounded state and typed signed-source service.

p1_findings.title: CPU and post-DC gates are conflated
p1_findings.required_fix: Use cycles, traffic and exact state-bit counts for the CPU gate; apply mapped area and Fmax only after VCS and paired DC.

p1_findings.title: candidate B JSON weakens exact cycle equality to one percent
p1_findings.required_fix: Set cycle, accept and bank-traffic delta to exact integer zero and inherit the r2 matched PTPX contract.

p2_findings: The 1.30 ratio-of-sums and 1.10 per-sample gates are reasonable single-sequence pre-RTL kill gates after the baseline and service model are repaired, but are not paper robustness evidence.

Candidate B must explicitly inherit exact net and leaf SAIF annotation of 100 percent, nonzero-toggle coverage, the same contiguous window and macro boundary, and dynamic power equal to internal plus switching.
OpenEye variable-length FIFO and row-stationary details need a specific primary-paper section or official RTL path before manuscript use.
required_r2_conditions: executable atomic-bundle context capacity or fully charged spill protocol
strongest output-stationary or Gustavson exact baseline
M218 six-slice service and full SRAM transaction model
same-cohort decoder share or no share gate
exact-zero B cycle delta and exact matched PTPX coverage
independently sealed M511 payload verifier and M513 production result before any run
